semantic.justification: Original header-owned cell/row/table hierarchy uses actual SvRefBase/SvRef and UNO range References, native by-value map parameter, open state, unsigned32 span/grid/depth, borrowed member pointer access, shallow shared row copies and completed/current row ownership. CellData::IsValid from TableManager.cxx is co-located with its owning class and retains start-only check, ignored temporary result and catch-only RuntimeException. Explicit reverse member/vector destruction follows language order and pinned native libc++ SvRef vector capture. No TableManager substitute or document projection is introduced. Physical C++ ABI/layout, native exception-copy allocation, threads, comprehensive generated reflection and whole-module compiled differential parity remain unverified. Full TableManager/DomainMapperTableManager, concrete Writer text-range/component services, DOCX/XLSX model/export and production desktop/mobile file UI workflows remain incomplete. Broad behavior/contract/default/verified flags stay unverified.
